text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... Gyuh... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Forget that! Look at the board!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
My number's up there! You see it? Look
already!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan points at the board,
jumping up
and down in excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's already left her mark on the
highest tier of
racing.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Not bad, huh?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan! There's a press
conference going
on and we'd love for
you to participate.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh?! A press conference? Me?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: 早速ビッグになるための一歩だな
早速ビッグになるための一歩だね

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Hehehe! Now watch how it's done. I'm
about to
go kill it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan is all bravado as she heads
over to
the press, but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... The next question is for
Tosen Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Eep!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to know your thoughts about
next steps
after today. Considering your
aptitude, I expect
you'll aim for medium
or long distance, but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So, uhh... like, what are you asking me?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! Okay, okay.
choice_data_list: 次の目標を聞いてるんだよ……！

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Uhh, the Triple Crown. I'm going for the
Triple
Crown, 'cause I... wanna make it
big!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So the Satsuki Sho, Japanese Derby, and
Shuka
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
R-right, that! The Satsuki Sho, Derby,
and Kikuka
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: You think she was being serious?

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Doubt it. Would someone serious about
the
Classic Triple Crown mess up the
names of its
races?

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text:
Plus, she was playing with her nails the
whole
time. Probably wasn't even paying
attention. I
wouldn't expect anything
from her.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It's fine. Honestly, I don't even care.
choice_data_list: ……君は本気で目指してるのに
……貴方は本気で目指してるのに

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
They'll see when I actually win the Triple
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Anyway, I'm gonna get changed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan walks back to the waiting
room in a
visible slump.

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's her... Is she crying?

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're Tosen Jordan's trainer,
right?

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, great! I'd love to observe her
training
sometime!

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text:
I was really intrigued by her performance
and
interview today. It's been a while
since I've seen
eyes so full of
determination.

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text:
So... was she really serious about going
for the
Triple Crown?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As long as she keeps running her way,
slowly but
surely more people will take
note of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And it'll all start with the Satsuki Sho.
